locator.title: Стоит ли покупать квартиру сейчас: мнение экспертов
locator.lead: Почему россияне активно покупают недвижимость в Москве и откуда берут средства
locator.caption: Максимальная высота домов в Левел Лесной — 15 этажей, поэтому здания не будут сильно загораживать вид на зелёные зоны

current_heading.text: Кто планирует переезд в 2026 году и какие квартиры покупают россияне

nearest_text_before.text: Некоторые проекты Level особенно нравятся возрастным покупателям. Например, Левел Лесной, который находится в зелёной зоне недалеко от Москвы, но в шаговой доступности от метро и больших столичных магистралей.

nearest_text_after.text: Что говорят эксперты: купить можно — и с умом

image_reading: High-angle aerial view of a modern residential complex with several mid-rise towers, streets, courtyards, and dense forest directly around it.
Warm sunlight catches the façades; the green canopy is a prominent, continuous backdrop around the buildings.
analysis.article_context: Body image illustrating Level Lesnoy: mid-rise residential buildings remain open to the surrounding green areas, supporting the article’s point about a nature-oriented location near Moscow.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The residential project offers comfortable urban homes while preserving an immediate connection to surrounding green spaces.
structured_intent.primary_action: The aerial viewpoint advances steadily toward the residential complex.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The final view clearly shows the residential buildings together with the broad, unobstructed tree canopy around them.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The homes remain visibly integrated with and open toward the surrounding green landscape.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, make a measured forward aerial drift toward the central cluster of homes, keeping the forest edge and the main buildings visible throughout. Subtle leaf movement gives the scene life. The approach eases near the end on a clear view of the complex surrounded by greenery.
models.positive_prompt: A slow aerial push toward the residential complex, with treetops gently stirring in a light breeze. End with the buildings clearly framed against the uninterrupted surrounding green canopy.

models.scene_plan: Use the full five seconds for a smooth, modest aerial approach centered on the residential quarter. The movement steadily brings the courtyards and façades closer while preserving the wooded perimeter in frame. Settle naturally near the end with the development visibly open to the green zone.
models.positive_prompt: Gently glide forward over the residential complex toward the central courtyards; nearby treetops move softly in the breeze. Finish with the mid-rise buildings and broad green surroundings clearly visible together.

models.scene_plan: Across four seconds, perform one controlled forward aerial move toward the center of the complex. Keep the focal buildings and surrounding trees continuously legible; add only gentle breeze-driven foliage motion. Reach a slightly closer final framing where the forest remains visibly dominant around the homes.
models.positive_prompt: A concise forward aerial glide toward the central residential buildings, with soft motion in the surrounding treetops. End on a clear view of the homes framed by the extensive green canopy.
